Rhea (PM): quick sync — proposing a compact rollout ladder for the new priority-routing feature. goals: protect committed SLAs, let sales opt-in customers, measurable A/B, and a fast surgical re-enable path. any immediate objections? :memo:
Owen (SRE): no objections. ops constraints: per-tenant circuit-breaker, token-budget caps, and a global kill-switch. safety gates: p95 > 300ms for 5m OR error-rate > 1% for 5m -> auto-fallback.
Kai (Backend): implement flags at scopes: global / tenant / experiment. sample flag YAML we can ship in the PR:
```
flags:
  priority_routing:
    enabled: true
    rollout_phase: "regional_canary"
    experiment: "priority_ab_01"
    fallback_variant: "baseline_v2"
```
Rhea (PM): proposed phases: 1) 24h shadow (no activation) 2) regional warmup + 10-tenant canary 3) 50-tenant A/B (control vs variant) 4) staged regional GA. each phase has clear rollback gates.
Lina (Sales): customers want guaranteed opt-out and re-enable SLA. propose "auto-opt-out-on-breach" plus a surgical re-enable SLA of 2-4h with on-call approval. will prepare comms template.
Owen (SRE): re-enable runbook: create ticket -> on-call approves -> 1-tenant staged re-enable during warm window (02:00-06:00 UTC) -> monitor 30m -> proceed. ops-bot will open incident automatically on safety-gate triggers.
ops-bot: scheduled job created: "priority-rollout-heartbeat" posts progress every 15m during rollout windows and creates an incident if a safety gate trips.
Kai (Backend): quick rollback curl snippet for runbook:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/flags \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"t-999","flag":"priority_routing","value":false}'
```
Rhea (PM): acceptance for GA: autopilot fallback tested in staging, dashboards live (per-tenant p50/p95, tokens/sec, fallback count), legal + sales SLA wording approved, runbook exercised, and A/B shows <0.5% error delta. action items: Kai -> flags PR + rollback snippet (today), Owen -> circuit-breaker + ops-bot rule + dashboards (EOD), Lina -> comms + opt-in list (tomorrow). target: regional canary next Wed during warm window. thanks all :rocket:
